assignment.title: Prompt Engineering Take-Home Assignment
assignment.context: As AI capabilities advance rapidly, engineers at Anthropic face a unique challenge: building tools and experiences that are genuinely useful, trustworthy, and delightful. The best products demonstrate taste, handle complexity gracefully, and solve real problems in non-obvious ways. This assignment asks you to demonstrate prompt engineering and evaluation skills through a focused, practical task.

time_expectation.note: Depth is more valuable than breadth. Stop and submit at the hard limit. Note time spent in the written rationale.

task.summary: Build a Claude + Wikipedia QA system and evaluate it

step.name: Design system prompt and tool definition
step.detail: For an LLM with access to a search_wikipedia(query: str) tool. The prompt should guide the model to use Wikipedia effectively to produce high-quality answers.

step.name: Wire up Wikipedia retrieval
step.detail: Make the system work end-to-end. Any approach is fine: MediaWiki API, dump, local index. Focus is on prompt quality, not production infrastructure.

step.name: Build an eval suite
step.detail: Measure how well the system works across a range of test cases. This is a first-class deliverable, not an afterthought.

deliverable.name: Runnable prototype
deliverable.requirement: Anthropic team must be able to run and interact with it
CLI, notebook, or script; shows whether search was used per answer
Include sample queries or a demo mode

deliverable.name: Code
deliverable.requirement: Any language/stack; code quality matters but is not the primary criterion

deliverable.name: Design rationale
deliverable.format: Self-recorded video (~5 min) + short written doc
deliverable.must_cover: Eval suite design: dimensions of quality chosen and why
Where the system succeeds and fails; learnings from evals
Key iterations made based on eval results
How you would extend this with more time

constraints.constraint: Use an Anthropic model via the Anthropic API. State the model in the writeup (e.g., Claude Sonnet 4, Claude Haiku 3.5).
Do NOT use built-in hosted search or RAG tools (Anthropic web_search tool type, OpenAI web browsing, Perplexity, etc.). Design the retrieval system yourself.
Wikipedia data source is your choice. Focus on prompt quality and eval design.

ai_usage.permitted: Claude Code, Claude.ai, or other AI tools during development
ai_usage.required: Submit Claude/AI transcripts alongside code. Evaluation covers your judgment: how you direct AI, evaluate outputs, make tradeoffs, maintain your own vision. A fully AI-generated project with no judgment will not pass.

submission.item: Clear instructions for running the prototype
Claude/AI transcripts (Claude Code transcripts or Claude.ai Share button)
